:::{#thm-addition-rule}
#### Addition

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $P$ and $Q$,
this is a [rule of inference](#def-rule-of-inference):

$$
\frac{P}{P \lor Q}
$$

:::

::: proof

Suppose the [premise](#def-premise) is true.
By the definition of [or](#def-or),
$P \lor Q$ is true
when $P$ is true.
So the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) $P \lor Q$ is true.

:::
